text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice and a Notice for the purposes of the Clearing Rules. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. About Mark Price: 3.1 Mark Price Methodology During the Pre-IPO Trading Period: Before the final IPO price is released, the Mark Price for Pre-IPO Perps is calculated using the following formula: Mark Price  = Average of last 10 seconds’ trade prices on Binance RIE, calculated every second. If there are less than 21 transaction prices in the 10 seconds interval, the system will check the number of transaction prices in the past 100 seconds. If there are more than 21, the average will be based on the transaction prices in the past 100 seconds; otherwise, it will be based on the last 100 transaction prices of the Pre-IPO contract. A ±1% of price cap will be imposed on the mark price where the price change is limited within ±1% range every second interval. This cap is applicable during the Pre-IPO trading and Pre-IPO standard perpetual transition period.  3.2 Pre-IPO Perp Transition  Pre-IPO Perps will transition to standard TradFi Perps when an Exchange Notice is published by Binance RIE confirming the transition (the “ Pre-IPO Transition Notice ”). This transition will occur on the day of the Official IPO Listing, when a stable Price Index can be derived from the third-party Data Vendors (as determined by Binance). The mark price will gradually converge from Pre-IPO trading Mark Price to the standard Mark Price calculation. There may be particular price volatility immediately following official listing and the share price may not ever reach the IPO price. 3.3 Mark Price After the Transition to TradFI Perp: Following the effective time specified in the Pre-IPO Transition Notice, the Mark Price will be calculated using the following formula:  Mark Price  = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price) Please refer to the  Clearing Procedures  and the  Mark Price and Price Index in USDⓈ-Margined Futures  for Price 1 and Price 2 formulas.  4. About Funding Rates: The Funding Rate is calculated in accordance with the  Clearing Procedures . There are two components to the funding rate: the interest rate and the premium. The interest rate for Pre-IPO Perps is fixed at 0.015% daily by default, or as otherwise specified in the  Funding Rate Table (USDS-M Futures) . Due to unavailability of the Premium Index for Pre-IPO Perps, the Funding Rate will be 0.005%, or as otherwise specified in the  Funding Rate Table (USDS-M Futures) , per Funding Interval, as the Funding Times occur every eight hours. Binance RCH will issue a Notice if the Funding Interval or interest rate is amended in respect of a Pre-IPO Perp. Following the transition to TradFi Perp, the Funding Rate will follow the standard TradFi Perp  Funding Rate Mechanism set out in the  Clearing Procedures .   5. Leverage & Margin Tiers: Binance RCH may adjust the maximum leverage and margin requirements in accordance with the  Clearing Rules  and the  Clearing Procedures . The applicable maximum leverage and margin requirements are set out below, or as amended and specified in the  Leverage & Margin Table (USDS-M Futures) . Please note that a stricter maximum price will be imposed during the Pre-IPO trading and Pre-IPO standard perpetual transition period. Binance may adjust the maximum price from time to time based on market risk conditions. API users may use  GET /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo  while UI users can refer to this  page  to find the latest maximum price.  The Pre-IPO Perp will be made available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. For more information on available Futures Copy Trading contracts, please refer to  this page . If the Pre-IPO Perp is transitioned to a TradFi Perp, a Pre-IPO Transition Notice will be issued.  If a Pre-IPO Perp is subject to a Failed IPO and the Contract is subject to Removal, an IPO Failure Notice will be issued.  Binance reserves the right to adjust the Contract Size of the Pre-IPO Perp when the actual share count is available. A separate announcement will be made if Binance decides to rebase.  Binance RIE may adjust the trading parameters of the Pre-IPO Perp from time to time, in accordance with the  Exchange Rules  and the  Exchange Procedures . The applicable trading parameters at any time are set out in the relevant  Contract Specifications  and in the  Trading Parameters Table (USDS-M Futures ). Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned Futures contract from time to time, which include the funding fee and tick size.  Binance RCH may adjust the maximum leverage and margin requirements in accordance with the  Clearing Rules  and the  Clearing Procedures . The applicable maximum leverage and margin requirements are set out in the  Leverage & Margin Table (USDS-M Futures) .  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
